card.what: Round stainless pad eye, 6 mm size: a 40 mm round base screwed down through four countersunk holes, with a round-bar loop for a shackle, a block or a line's end
card.boats: kit part (not yet placed by a layout): jib sheet and vang anchor points, the J/22's foredeck and cockpit tie-downs, a Sunfish's mainsheet ratchet base
card.distance: arm's reach on the deck; the camera passes close in the cockpit
card.before: kit Padeye from bk_parts.padeye (Oct 2026): a U-bolt on a 50 x 30 mm rectangular plate with two nuts

features.text: Round base with a rounded top edge and a flat underside
Four big countersunk screw holes on the diagonals, reaching nearly to the rim
Round-bar loop, a tall rounded arch whose legs land between the holes
Soft fillets where the loop meets the base: one forging, no seams or nuts
Room through the loop for a 6 mm shackle pin or a 10 mm line (about 19 mm wide and 16 mm high inside; catalogue W 17, h 17)
A small maker's mark on the top face (made-up TERNWAY lettering, no real brand)

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
